p0.title: Terminal and common cycle semantics match compact counts but not the frozen persistent state and one-resource priority machine
evidence: terminal state, clear counters and committed bitmap are local to each terminal_tail call, while CycleLedger is recreated per sample/layer/time/architecture row; no ten-time, four-layer or ten-sample receipt state persists

word 1023 leaves the local state as DIRECTORY_CLEAR_WORD and line 1286 directly transitions DIRECTORY_CLEAR_WORD to TIME_RETIRE under a DIRECTORY_CLEAR_END event, omitting the frozen T05 next-state DIRECTORY_CLEAR_END
weight refill, restore and writeback use three resource-owner names although the frozen coordinate has one external link
a synthetic busy acquire charges one conflict cycle and then raises resource re-entry instead of holding and retrying on the next common-priority edge
p0.impact: Minimal 18/18/22/21 and 2/1029 goldens can pass while formal rows are off the frozen same-resource cycle coordinate.

p0.title: Descriptor and final-output protocol mismatches retain executable false-pass paths
evidence: FrontierTracker tracks only remaining count per ordinal and never compares descriptor_accept_sha256 with descriptor_retire_sha256
synthetic accept(A,B) followed by retire(A,A) closed the frontier with accepted=2, retired=2 and protocol_mismatches=0 while hashes differed
transition_mismatches is never incremented and source_time_output_cycle_mismatches is only conservation plus that permanently-zero counter
final-output hold and address tests compare values with their immediately assigned selves/formulas and no independent owner/address/beat/cursor oracle is gated
p0.impact: Descriptor replacement/duplication or output protocol errors can satisfy exact_gate and false-pass GO/support.

p0.title: Hidden-resource, occupancy and mandatory aggregate-ledger predicates remain incomplete
evidence: hidden_resource_gate checks only the constant 239636<=245760 and final_state_empty, not measured ingress/context/context-slot/O8/FIFO4/pending-write/resident occupancy against limits
the required single 128-byte-per-cycle external link is not a common executable owner across refill, restore, writeback and final output
per-sample-layer T10 exact ledgers and every-layer ratios imported from r2 are absent, and common hash gating omits descriptor-retire, terminal and accepted-output protocol identity
GO and support conjoin the incomplete hidden-resource and mismatch predicates
p0.impact: A hidden port/capacity violation or incomplete mandatory ledger can still publish PASS_CPU_GO or PASS_CPU_SUPPORT_ONLY.

p1.title: Wrapper attestation checks cmdline membership rather than actual parent execution identity
evidence: verify_wrapper_descriptor accepts any parent cmdline containing the canonical wrapper path in any argument
a non-wrapper parent can use that path as a dummy argument and self-report its PID/starttime in the read-only descriptor
verify_review permits arbitrary extra JSON keys and alternate p0/p1 field locations rather than an exact stage key set

p1.title: Dangling canonical symlinks bypass output absence and failure quarantine
evidence: preflight and failure_close use Path.exists instead of lexists plus explicit no-symlink checks
a synthetic dangling result symlink survived failure_close with exists=false, is_symlink=true and lexists=true
ordinary post-rename directory failure did quarantine and reseal correctly

p2.title: Builtin self-test does not exercise the remaining protocol, terminal, resource or failure false-pass cases
p2.evidence: The four architecture check is cycle-length-only; exact production golden comparison exists in preflight and passed when called independently, but no duplicate-retire, terminal-state, shared-link, occupancy, output-protocol or dangling-symlink fault is included.

busy_resource.result: ContractFailure resource re-entry instead of hold/retry
